chapter: Chicago, the Woodside, the army and 52nd Street
title: Joe Eldridge, Roy's brother
summary: Joe was a fine writer and saxophonist who joined Roy's band when Scoops Carey left.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Speaking of Joey Eldridge, he was a very fine saxophone player, but unfortunately he -- you know, was kind of -- he was always in the background because of Roy. Roy was such a brilliant musician. But Joe wrote very well, he was a

very -- a good writer, arranger, and a very good saxophone player. When Scoops Carey left Roy's band, Joe joined us and stayed with Roy as long as I was there. But I'll -- Scoops Carey. We came up together in Chicago. He was a great Yardbird saxophone player. Now, he was like the odd bird. How?
